children: Costco Wholesale Corp. (COST, Financials), the bulk seller of common products through its membership warehouses, is boosting motor oil prices and limiting purchases.
It's a tiny adjustment in Costco's huge company, but the timing makes it worth keeping an eye on.
Energy markets have been under pressure and increasing oil prices might eventually be felt by consumers at the gas pump, in shipping costs and on store shelves.

Motor oil seems to be one of those areas. Costco's reputation has a lot to do with keeping prices low for members. When costs go up, the company has to figure out how much of the increase it can absorb and how much it has to pass on to buyers.
The purchase restrictions make things tricky. That seems Costco would prefer to retain goods on hand than to risk certain consumers purchasing an exceptionally big amount.
Only motor oil won't budge Costco's earnings The key question is if this is an isolated incident.
If similar price increases start to surface on more products, Costco buyers could feel the sting of increasing energy costs in a far larger way. That is the next thing investors should watch.

title: Costco raises motor oil prices as supply pressure builds
